import pytest


def parity(x: int) -> bool:
    """Return True when the byte x (0 to 255) has an odd number of set bits."""
    if not (0 <= x <= 255):
        raise ValueError(f"Value out of byte range [0, 255]: {x}")
    return x.bit_count() % 2 == 1


def test_parity_zero() -> None:
    assert parity(0) is False


def test_parity_single_bit() -> None:
    assert parity(1) is True
    assert parity(2) is True
    assert parity(128) is True


def test_parity_powers_and_combinations() -> None:
    assert parity(3) is False  # 0b00000011 -> 2 bits (even)
    assert parity(7) is True  # 0b00000111 -> 3 bits (odd)
    assert parity(15) is False  # 0b00001111 -> 4 bits (even)
    assert parity(255) is False  # 0b11111111 -> 8 bits (even)
    assert parity(254) is True  # 0b11111110 -> 7 bits (odd)


def test_parity_out_of_range() -> None:
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parity(-1)
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        parity(256)
